Name: Abihail, Son of Huri
Summary: Son of Huri son of Jaroah son of Gilead, father of the Gadite brethren listed after him.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:14: Son of Huri son of Jaroah son of Gilead, father of the Gadite brethren listed after him.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Abihail stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
